tabs.desc: HM3D ObjectNav v1 val mip100 · the same loop, the goal is an object category · 200 turns · 500 steps · 2400 s. Success = STOP within a radius of the goal object's nearest viewpoint. The benchmark's own 0.1 m line is a knife-edge for an agent that is told to stop about a metre from the object, so the board ranks by 1.0 m and prints 0.25 m and the official 0.1 m beside it. The rows are the first boards on the hash-spec draw at 200 turns (the two 2026-10-04 boards on the old August draw at 150 turns were replaced on 2026-10-09/10; they sit in outputs/claudecode/_old_draw_20261004). v1 is the Habitat Challenge 2022 pool: 20 val scenes, 2,000 episodes, longer paths than v2 (geodesic median 6.0 m vs 4.8 m). The Hybrid rows add waypoint moves (observe_waypoints() / goto()) to Minimal's tools, without the SLAM instruments (see Interfaces below).
